blocked.one: {n} track blocked by a plugin to install
blocked.other: {n} tracks blocked by a plugin to install

title: Releases
intro: Your singles, EPs and albums: the tracks in order, where each one stands, what's left before the date.
firstText: Group songs into a single, EP or album to follow where each track stands and what's left before the release date.
hintsTitle: Your folders that look like releases
hintsText: Their name says EP, LP or album. Making one a release takes its songs in the order of their names; you can reorder them afterwards.

page.arrangeTitle: Shows first which folders would move and where. Nothing moves until you confirm.
page.physOff: This release only exists in the app. To arrange its folders on disk too, turn on physical arranging in {link}.
page.nothingAlready: Nothing to move: its songs are already in "{target}".
page.nothingCant: Nothing to move: no folder can be moved.

movesExisting.one: The folder of {n} song will go into the folder:
movesExisting.other: The folders of {n} songs will go into the folder:

movesNew.one: The folder of {n} song will go into a new folder:
movesNew.other: The folders of {n} songs will go into a new folder:

page.checked: Every project is checked: a project that would lose a sample is not moved. Ctrl+Z puts everything back.
page.pickParent: Which folder should the release go in?
page.addPh: + Add a song: title, artist or folder
page.boardHint: Drop files here from Explorer (pictures, sounds, MIDI), or send samples, MIDI files or renders: the "Send to a mood board" button on the Samples and MIDI pages, or a right-click on a file.
page.whatHappens: If you confirm, these song folders are moved (not copied) into this folder, with everything in them: projects, samples, renders. Live finds everything as before. Other files are not touched.
page.ftTip: Collaborators on every track of the release: added here, they go on each one; taken away, they leave each one.

singles.title: Songs marked single
singles.text: Their type says "Single", but no release holds them yet. One click makes each a release (single), to date and follow like the others.
